understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate the grid and complete every level by moving the carried piece onto each goal cell after matching the goal’s required shape, color, and rotation.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement consumes stamina, and blocked moves still consume stamina without changing position. Shape modifiers cycle the piece’s shape, color modifiers cycle its color, and rotation modifiers rotate it 90° clockwise. A goal is completed only when all three attributes match simultaneously upon entering its cell. Depleting stamina costs a life and resets stamina; losing all lives ends the game.
